Browser launch fails when browser mode is always but browser is unavailable

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const crawlberg = @import("crawlberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    if (crawlberg.scrape("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\",\"timeout\":1}}", "https://example.com")) |_| {
        return error.TestUnexpectedResult;
    } else |err| { std.debug.print("call failed as expected: {s}\n", .{@errorName(err)}); }
}
```
